summary.zh: 用 LangChain 与 LangGraph 组织智能体与工具
summary.en: Structure agents, memory and tools in LangGraph

description.zh: 梳理 LangChain 1.x 与 LangGraph 中 agent、memory 和工具接入的组织方式，并给出复杂工作流的分层思路。适合从原型走向多步骤 LLM 应用时设计结构。需要具备 Python 与 LangChain 基础。
description.en: Covers how agents, memory and tool integration fit together in LangChain 1.x and LangGraph, with a layered view of complex workflows. Suits moving from prototype to multi-step LLM app. Requires Python and LangChain basics.
